open_points.subject: perform_service_operation
open_points.text: perform_service_operation: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST build one PreparedServiceCall of the identified service, the request, the instant recorded_now gives once for the call, and as principal an ActingPrincipal of the AGENT_VIA_KERNEL member of = models.PrincipalKind with the service and kernel_session_id when service_may_call answered agent_authority true, which it answers only for the CABINET_KERNEL member of = models.ServiceName (A10), and otherwise of the SERVICE member of = models.PrincipalKind with the service and no session_id.
open_points.rule: Таблица — это когда по члену перечисления выбирается значение: член другого перечисления, код, категория. Такое соответствие — само значение, таблица соответствий, даже когда оно сводится к «один член — одно, остальные — другое»; подмножество членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list.
open_points.question: Remove the inline ServiceName-to-agent_authority mapping from this note and preserve the CABINET_KERNEL-only guarantee through an imported provider constant or through the service_may_call provider's own specification.
